title: Cinnamon Rolls
instructions: Heat up the milk until lukewarm and add the yeast and a spoon of sugar, set aside to bloom.
Take bloomed yeast, softened butter and half of the sugar, mix it together in a bowl.
Add dry ingredients now - flour, salt.
Knead for 8 to 10 minutes, then let rest for an hour in a greased out bowl. Put a bit of oil on the dough as well and cover with a wet towel.
Roll up into a rectangle, spread some butter on top, sprinkle cinnamon and sugar and vanilla.
Roll it up into a roll, cut into individual pieces, and put it into a baking dish, pieces should be touching slightly.
Cover with a foil and let rest for an hour.
Slather some more butter on top, and bake at 180C for 15-25 minutes, until nice and golden.
